newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela mulls move to dollar accounting.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela mulls move to dollar accounting.

text.p: Venezuela's vice minister of Energy and Mines Evanan Romero said Tuesday the government was putting together a dollar-accounting mechanism to shield foreign investors from the effect of domestic inflation on their tax bills.
He said that over the past 15 years, many investors had incurred losses due to accounting laws that write-up gains in asset values during years of high inflation. Those gains are taxable.

One solution was "to help you eliminate this uncertainty by introducing a mechanism whereby investors could use a hard currency of their choice to... pay their taxes," he said at an oil and mining seminar.
"Of course this would require an amendment of the law. As soon as we have agreement on that... we will introduce this amendment to Congress," he added.
Romero said the Ministry of Energy and the Ministry of Finance was currently drawing up an amendment for consideration by congress.
